title: Brown Sugar Pecan Brittle
description: Pecan brittle doesn't get faster or easier than this recipe with only five ingredients: butter, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla, and pecans.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or more to taste
1 cup crushed pecans, or more to taste

steps.text: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir brown sugar in hot butter until dissolved. Add cinnamon and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Stir vanilla into brown sugar mixture; cook and stir until vanilla stops sizzling, about 30 seconds. Add pecans; cook and stir until pecans are fragrant and lightly toasted, about 1 minute. Pour pecan mixture out in a layer on parchment paper. Let cool to room temperature before breaking into pieces, about 20 minutes.
